store.0: Living in Kansas means I need to be flexible. Some days I can walk outside, but other times I'm stuck inside due to freezing winters or storms. I'm a mid-50s person and do my best to stay active, eat right, and manage my stress through balance.
store.1: For exercise, consistency is more important than intensity. Walking is my best friend for osteoarthritis and blood sugar management. I try to do light yoga a few times a week. On bad weather days, I use a stationary bike or do some at-home workouts. Nothing fancy, just enough to keep me moving.
store.2: For hydration, I keep a big water bottle with me all day and drink herbal teas in the evening instead of coffee. Kansas summers can be brutal, so I make sure to drink even more water when it’s hot outside.
